title: Documentation
text: CLI 0.9.0 , templates 0.6.0 . Miblo generates Rust APIs. Node.js and OpenAPI generation are not available. Miblo provides the structure. You implement business rules, authentication and deployment in the generated project. The current terminal interface and generated README use French; this guide keeps the actual menu labels so you can find them.

title: Installation
text: Install Miblo for Rust API development on Windows, macOS or Linux. Rust, Cargo and rustfmt are required.

title: Installation
text: Install Rust 1.88 or later , Cargo and rustfmt through rustup . The formatter is used when generating and merging Rust code. rustup update stable rustup component add rustfmt rustc --version cargo --version System Native build tools macOS Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install Linux A C/C++ compiler and linker, such as build-essential on Debian/Ubuntu. Windows Visual Studio Build Tools with “Desktop development with C++”, and the Rust MSVC toolchain. SQLite needs no database server. Python, Docker and sqlx-cli are not required to use Miblo.

title: Installation
text: cargo install miblo --locked miblo --version The first compilation can take several minutes. --locked keeps the tested dependency versions. Install from a local checkout cargo install --path . --locked

title: Installation
text: miblo This opens the terminal workspace. A project is opened automatically when the current directory contains miblo.yaml . miblo ui --project path/to/my-api Without an interactive terminal, bare miblo prints help. CLI subcommands are available for scripts.

title: Installation
text: Download a prebuilt Miblo 0.9.0 beta for your system: Windows x64 · SHA-256 macOS Apple Silicon · SHA-256 macOS Intel · SHA-256 Linux x64 (glibc 2.35+) · SHA-256 Extract the archive and place miblo (or miblo.exe ) in a directory on your PATH . On macOS/Linux, preserve its executable permission. Then run miblo --version in a terminal. Rust, Cargo, rustfmt and native build tools are still required to compile generated APIs. These beta binaries are unsigned and not notarized; installation with Cargo builds Miblo from source. Release notes and all archives . Templates are downloaded automatically on first use.

title: Installation
text: Open a new terminal and check that Cargo’s binary directory is in your PATH : usually ~/.cargo/bin on Unix or %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin on Windows. If linking fails, check your system’s native build tools. See troubleshooting for other errors.

title: Create your first API
text: Create a Rust API with SQLite, add a User model and send a POST request from Miblo.

title: Create your first API
text: miblo Press n and enter team-api . Choose a directory that does not exist yet, then port 3000 . Select SQLite — fichier local, configuration automatique (local file, automatic setup). Choose GitHub Releases , then Créer le projet (create project). Miblo creates the project and miblo.sqlite . The database status reads Migrations à jour (migrations up to date).

title: Create your first API
text: Press a and enter User . Add name , type Texte court (short text), with no options. Select Ajouter un autre champ (add another field): email , also short text. Toggle Unique with Space . Select Terminer et générer (finish and generate), accept /users , then Générer . Miblo creates the users table with an id primary key, Rust code and five CRUD routes. With the API stopped, the new SQLite model migration is applied automatically.

title: Create your first API
text: Press r and wait for API en cours (API running). Use Tab to reach Routes, select POST /users , then press x . The fields are prefilled. Press Enter to edit a value. Select Envoyer la requête (send request) and press Enter . The response is HTTP 201 . Test GET /users to retrieve the created row. s stops the API. The first Rust build takes longer than subsequent starts.

title: Create your first API
section: The same steps in the shell
text: miblo new team-api --database sqlite --yes cd team-api miblo add User name:string email:string:unique --yes miblo db init miblo run Open miblo in a second terminal inside team-api to test routes. An API started elsewhere is identified as external.

title: Create your first API
text: Press m to add a field , g to create a route , d to inspect the schema , or e to open the code.

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: Navigate Miblo’s terminal workspace, manage your API and read its status indicators.

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: Key Action ↑ / ↓ or j / k Move the selection. Tab / Shift+Tab Switch panels. Enter Confirm or open the selection. Escape Close a dialog or cancel input. Space Open Actions; toggle a form option. ? Open help. Panels display models, files, routes, HTTP responses and logs. d switches from routes to the schema. v hides the compact code preview. Minimum terminal size: 70 × 20 . The code preview hides automatically below 30 rows.

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: Key Action n / o Create / open an API a Add model, table and CRUD m Add fields or relationships to an existing model g Create a route r / s Start / stop the API b Configure, initialize or migrate the database d / p Show schema / switch its source x / Enter Test the selected route f Custom HTTP request e Open code in your editor c Run cargo check u Update templates for future additions t / F5 Change theme / refresh q Quit

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: Press : to enter a workspace command: :new :open path/to/project :add :model :run :stop :db :migrate :schema :templates :routes :route-new :route :request :code :check :test :doctor :edit :refresh :theme :help :quit Workspace commands are not all CLI subcommands. Use the CLI reference for scripts.

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: Color API Database Green HTTP health check responds. Connected; migrations up to date. Orange Starting or restart required. Initialization or pending migrations. Red Process or response error. Connection failed or inconsistent migration. Gray Stopped or no project. Check pending or no database. Status refreshes about every three seconds. Miblo identifies an externally started API and does not stop that process.

title: Terminal interface and shortcuts
text: e uses VISUAL , then EDITOR , then vi on Unix or notepad on Windows. Arguments such as EDITOR="code --wait" are supported. Miblo restores the terminal while you edit. Any key skips the blue startup animation; set MIBLO_NO_ANIMATION=1 to disable it. Three session themes are available. Normal exit stops the processes Miblo started. Finish generation, compilation and HTTP jobs first: exit is blocked while those jobs are running.

title: Models and fields
text: Generate a SQL table, Rust model and five CRUD endpoints from a model definition.

title: Models and fields
text: Press a and name the model, for example User . Name a field, choose its type and toggle options with Space . Add fields or a relationship from Champs de la ressource (resource fields). Select Terminer et générer , confirm the collection path, then Générer . id is added automatically. Use field names such as first_name . Escape cancels before generation. miblo add User name:string email:string:unique --yes miblo add Product title:string price:float active:bool --yes --path /members changes the collection path. Without fields or --yes , the CLI starts its wizard.

title: Models and fields
text: Type Rust SQLite MySQL string String TEXT VARCHAR(255) text String TEXT TEXT int i64 INTEGER BIGINT float f64 REAL DOUBLE bool bool INTEGER BOOLEAN Optional fields use Option<T> . Syntax: name:type?:option , for example description:text? .

title: Models and fields
text: Option Example Behavior Optional nickname:string? Accepts NULL. Unique email:string:unique Adds a unique constraint. Use string, rather than text, for unique text. Private token:string:private Accepts writes; omits the value from CRUD responses. Common sensitive names (password, password_hash, secret, token, api_key) become private through the CLI. This filtering does not encrypt data or add authentication.

title: Models and fields
text: Method User path Result GET /users Paginated list: limit and offset, at most 100 rows per page. POST /users Create: 201. GET /users/{id} Row or 404. PATCH /users/{id} Update supplied fields; omitted fields remain unchanged. DELETE /users/{id} Delete: 204; missing row: 404. Unknown fields and invalid types are rejected. Unique conflicts return 409. Empty PATCH requests, changing id and NULL for required fields are rejected.

title: Models and fields
text: Adding a model writes its files and migration without regenerating existing resources. Registries, miblo.yaml and .miblo/state.json are updated. --dry-run previews the plan. File collisions or managed registry conflicts stop the operation. Use miblo edit or m to add a field.

title: Relationships and foreign keys
text: Connect Rust API models with SQL foreign keys, indexes and deletion rules.

title: Relationships and foreign keys
text: Create Group with a name field. Add User with a . After its fields, select Ajouter une relation (clé étrangère) (add a foreign key). Select Group → groups.id and accept group_id . Choose options and a deletion rule. Finish and confirm generation. Miblo generates an integer field, index and SQL constraint. For an existing User, use m → Ajouter une relation facultative (add an optional relationship). miblo add Group name:string --yes miblo add User name:string 'group_id:int?:ref=Group' --yes

title: Relationships and foreign keys
text: Rule Effect on related rows RESTRICT (default) Prevents deleting a referenced row. CASCADE Also deletes rows that reference it. SET NULL Keeps related rows and clears the reference; requires an optional field. miblo add Note body:text 'user_id:int?:ref=User:on_delete=set_null' --yes

title: Relationships and foreign keys
text: :unique allows each non-NULL referenced value in only one row. Self-references are supported: miblo add Folder name:string 'parent_id:int?:ref=Folder:on_delete=set_null' --yes CRUD exposes IDs, without automatic joins or nested objects. Custom or composite primary keys and automatic many-to-many tables are not generated.

title: Relationships and foreign keys
text: Press d to open the actual database schema. Select a table to see columns, primary and foreign keys, and deletion rules. p switches to declared models. F5 refreshes; d returns to routes. Manually created tables are visible too. Internal SQLite and SQLx tables are hidden. This view shows structure; test routes to read rows. miblo db schema --project team-api

title: Update models and migrations
text: Add optional fields or relationships to existing tables while keeping their rows.

title: Update models and migrations
text: Stop the API with s , then press m . Choose the model and Ajouter un champ facultatif (add optional field). Enter nickname , choose Texte court (short text), then confirm the options. Select Terminer et générer , review the SQL and confirm. Miblo generates an ALTER TABLE migration and Rust changes. Existing rows receive NULL when the migration is applied. miblo edit User 'nickname:string?' --dry-run miblo edit User 'nickname:string?' --yes For a relationship, choose Ajouter une relation facultative and the target model. Deletion rules apply here too.

title: Update models and migrations
text: The database status becomes Mise à jour BDD requise (database update required). Press b → Appliquer les migrations (apply migrations), then confirm. Wait for Migrations à jour , then start with r . Editing a model does not automatically apply its migration, including with SQLite. Starting the generated API also applies pending migrations. miblo db migrate miblo run Keep already applied migration files unchanged.

title: Update models and migrations
text: Miblo merges generated code with your edits. A conflict stops the operation before writing. Existing handlers and services in the current architecture remain unchanged when adding a field. Replaced files are copied to .miblo/backups/ . These are source and metadata backups, not database backups.

title: Update models and migrations
text: Automated Implement in your project Add an optional field, possibly unique. Rename, remove or change a column type. Add an optional relationship. Change an existing relationship or make a field required. Additions preserve existing rows. Miblo does not choose backfill values for them.

title: Create API routes
text: Connect a new HTTP endpoint to a model’s SQL-backed CRUD, or generate a custom handler and service.

title: Create API routes
text: Press g and select User . Choose Créer une ligne (create a row). POST is selected automatically. Enter /members , then accept or change the proposed function name. Confirm Créer les fichiers (create files). Restart with s , then r , to load the route. This endpoint uses User’s existing CRUD and SQL queries. It writes to users ; it does not create another table. miblo route add create_member --resource User --action create --path /members --yes

title: Create API routes
text: CLI action Method Example path list GET /members get GET /members/{id} create POST /members update PATCH /members/{id} delete DELETE /members/{id} Single-row actions require exactly one {id} parameter. List and create accept none. Different methods can share a path with distinct module names. miblo route add members --resource User --action list --path /members --yes miblo route add member --resource User --action get --path '/members/{id}' --yes A list action at /users/active still returns a paginated list. Naming a path does not implement a filter or permission rule.

title: Create API routes
text: In g , select Logique personnalisée — sans modèle (custom logic without a model), or a model followed by Logique personnalisée — à compléter (501) . Choose method, path, function name and optional request body. miblo route add activate_user --method POST --path '/users/{id}/activate' --resource User --json-body --yes handlers.rs , requests.rs and service.rs are created in src/resources/custom_routes/activate_user/ . The route returns 501 until its business function is implemented. Select the route and press e . The function receives the SQL pool, path parameters, query parameters and optional JSON. Adapt the types, implement the behavior, then restart.

title: Create API routes
text: Model actions require template pack 0.6.0 . In older projects, use u → GitHub Releases, or miblo template update . Existing models keep their architecture. Paths use /segments/{parameters}, without query strings or wildcards. Duplicate method/path pairs and known CRUD or /health collisions are rejected. GET reserves HEAD. Check routes registered outside Miblo yourself. --dry-run previews the plan; --offline uses cached templates.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: Send POST and PATCH requests with prefilled forms, and inspect HTTP responses inside Miblo.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: Start the API with r . Select a POST route and press x . Préparer la requête (prepare request) shows the model fields. Use arrows to choose a value and Enter to edit it. Select Envoyer la requête and press Enter . You do not write JSON. Optional fields start at NULL , private values are masked and id is excluded. Unique example values change for each new request draft.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: Form key Effect Enter Edit the selected value. Space Include or exclude a field. n Set an optional field to NULL. Home Return to Send request. Escape Close input or cancel the request. PATCH fields start excluded and retain their database values. Include only the fields you want to change. Empty PATCH requests are rejected.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: Foreign keys offer up to 20 rows fetched through the target model’s collection endpoint. A required reference is preselected when a row is available. Otherwise create the target row first or enter an existing ID. The tester never creates a related row automatically. Optional references can stay NULL.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: f opens a custom request: GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS. Known CRUD paths receive their model fields. + adds a text, integer, decimal or boolean field; Delete removes it. For custom routes associated with a model, fields are editable suggestions, not an inferred request contract. Form edits do not change your models. Nested payloads, inference from handwritten Rust types and custom authentication headers are not supported yet. Use an external HTTP client for those cases.

title: Test HTTP routes
text: Miblo shows HTTP status, elapsed time and a formatted response. Timeout: 10 seconds; displayed body: 64 KiB; redirects are not followed. No write request is sent before you explicitly choose Send. Bodyless DELETE requests ask for confirmation. Escape goes back or cancels. Status Meaning 200 / 201 / 204 Read or update / created / deleted without content. 400 / 422 Check values, JSON shape or types. 404 Route or row not found. 409 Unique or foreign-key constraint conflict. 501 Custom function needs implementation.

title: SQLite and MySQL
text: Configure SQLite automatically or connect Miblo to MySQL, then inspect and apply SQL migrations.

title: SQLite and MySQL
text: Choose SQLite when creating a project. Miblo prepares .env , creates miblo.sqlite and applies initial migrations. No database server is needed. Miblo operation SQLite migration Create project Applied automatically. Add model with API stopped Applied automatically. Edit model with m Apply with b or on the next API start. DATABASE_URL=sqlite://miblo.sqlite?mode=rwc The generated API also creates a missing database file and applies migrations at startup.

title: SQLite and MySQL
text: Start a MySQL server, then choose MySQL when creating the project. Enter host, port, database, username and password in Miblo. Confirm Enregistrer la connexion MySQL ? (save connection). It is written to .env . In b , select Initialiser la base et ses tables (initialize database and tables), then confirm. The MySQL account needs permission for the requested operation. Miblo does not start a MySQL server. Use the included compose.yaml For local development, use the generated MySQL service and connection values from .env.example . docker compose up -d db # Once MySQL is ready: miblo db init miblo run

title: SQLite and MySQL
text: Command Effect miblo db check Test the connection. miblo db init Initialize if needed and apply migrations. miblo db migrate Apply pending migrations. miblo db schema Print the actual schema as JSON. --project PATH selects a project in another directory. Passwords are not passed as command arguments.

title: SQLite and MySQL
text: Miblo’s database commands read DATABASE_URL from the project’s .env first, falling back to the environment if absent. The generated API uses its runtime configuration; avoid conflicting file and shell values. The database engine is selected at creation. Switching engines requires a separate code and data migration. The schema view distinguishes the actual database from declared models.

title: Generated Rust code
text: Find your Axum handlers, request types, business logic and SQLx queries in the generated project.

title: Generated Rust code
text: src/ ├── main.rs # Server startup ├── lib.rs # Shared state and route assembly ├── config.rs # Environment configuration ├── database.rs # SQL pool and migrations ├── error.rs # Error responses ├── patch.rs # Omitted / NULL / value └── resources/ ├── mod.rs # Registry managed by Miblo └── user/ ├── mod.rs # User routes ├── handlers.rs # HTTP extraction and responses ├── model.rs # Data structures ├── requests.rs # Request types and validation ├── service.rs # Business rules └── repository.rs # SQL and transactions SQL migrations live in migrations/. Additional routes live in src/resources/custom_routes/. The generated French README explains configuration, files and requests.

title: Generated Rust code
text: Change File Business rule service.rs Request validation requests.rs SQL query repository.rs HTTP extraction and response handlers.rs Manually registered routes src/lib.rs , outside managed registries A write follows handler → service → repository . Code is formatted with rustfmt and includes focused comments.

title: Generated Rust code
text: cargo check cargo test cargo run The API runs without Miblo. SQLx queries run at runtime: building does not need a live database or .sqlx directory. A lockfile pins dependencies. The scaffold includes health, PATCH deserialization and request-validation tests in the current architecture. Add tests for your own business logic.

title: Generated Rust code
text: Commit miblo.yaml and .miblo/state.json alongside your source. They retain definitions, pinned templates and merge baselines. src/resources/mod.rs and custom_routes/mod.rs are managed registries. Business code there can block additions. Customize resource files or route assembly in src/lib.rs.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: Download versioned Miblo templates, verify their checksums and reuse them offline.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: New projects use format 3 and template packs 0.6.0 . The CLI also reads formats 1 and 2. Database Pack SQLite rust-axum-sqlite.tar.gz MySQL rust-axum-mysql.tar.gz Each archive has a .sha256 sidecar. Projects pin the version, URL, digest and fingerprint. Templates are downloaded separately, not embedded in the binary.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: miblo add Note body:text --yes --offline Offline mode requires previously downloaded templates. --cache-dir or MIBLO_CACHE_DIR selects the cache directory; otherwise XDG_CACHE_HOME, LOCALAPPDATA or ~/.cache/miblo is used. The template cache is separate from Cargo’s cache. Offline compilation also requires the Rust dependencies.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: Press u , choose GitHub Releases, a local directory or a URL, then confirm Mettre à jour (update). miblo template update --project team-api The new pack is used for future models and routes. Existing models retain their pinned templates, source files and migrations.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: miblo new team-api --database sqlite \ --template-base-url https://templates.example.com --yes miblo new team-api --database sqlite \ --template-url https://templates.example.com/custom/api.tar.gz \ --template-version 0.6.0 --yes miblo new team-api --database sqlite \ --template-dir ../miblo_templates/rust_sqlite_template_v4 --yes Replace example URLs with your server. A base URL is followed by /v0.6.0/<stack>.tar.gz. --sha256 HEX supplies a known digest. HTTPS is required except for loopback testing. A local pack contains manifest.json and Handlebars files. Keep it available and unchanged. Releases avoid maintaining a local template directory.

title: Templates and offline mode
text: Miblo verifies SHA-256 and rejects corrupt archives, links, unexpected files and paths escaping the extraction directory. A new version requires a new archive. A checksum verifies downloaded content; it is not a publisher signature.

title: CLI command reference
text: Miblo commands and options for project creation, models, routes, databases and templates.

title: CLI command reference
text: miblo --help miblo --version miblo new --help miblo route add --help Command Purpose miblo Open the workspace in an interactive terminal. miblo ui --project PATH Open a project. miblo new [NAME] Create an API. miblo add [NAME] [FIELD]... Add a model. miblo edit NAME [FIELD]... Add optional fields. miblo route add NAME --path PATH Create a route. miblo run --project PATH Run cargo run. miblo doctor --project PATH Check metadata, registries and prerequisites. miblo db ACTION --project PATH check, init, migrate or schema. miblo template update Update templates for future additions.

title: CLI command reference
text: miblo new shop-api --database sqlite --port 3000 \ --resource Product --field title:string --field price:float --yes Option Purpose --output PATH Destination; an existing directory is refused. --database sqlite|mysql SQLite by default interactively; MySQL with --yes and no explicit engine. --port PORT Default: 3000. --resource NAME / --field FIELD Initial model and repeated fields. --config PATH Version 1 YAML definition. --template-dir PATH Local pack; incompatible with direct URL/digest options. --template-url URL Direct archive URL. --template-base-url URL Distribution server. --template-version VERSION Pack version. --sha256 HEX Known digest without fetching a sidecar. --yes / --dry-run Accept choices / preview without writing the project. --offline / --cache-dir PATH Template cache options.

title: CLI command reference
text: miblo add User name:string email:string:unique --yes miblo edit User 'nickname:string?' --yes Supply fields positionally or with repeated --field options, never both. The legacy miblo add resource User --field name:string --yes syntax is still accepted. Shared options: --project, --yes, --dry-run, --offline, --cache-dir. add also accepts --path. edit requires optional fields and an existing model.

title: CLI command reference
text: miblo route add create_member --resource User --action create --path /members --yes miblo route add activate --method POST --path '/users/{id}/activate' --resource User --json-body --yes --action list|get|create|update|delete requires --resource and determines the method. Without an action, --method and --json-body describe a custom stub. Other options: --project, --yes, --dry-run, --offline, --cache-dir.

title: CLI command reference
text: miblo template update --project team-api --dry-run miblo template update --project team-api Options: --template-dir or --template-url, --template-version, --template-base-url, --project, --dry-run, --offline and --cache-dir. Check --help for your installed version before automating a new workflow.

title: Configuration
text: Project files and environment variables used by Miblo and your generated Rust API.

title: Configuration
text: File Purpose miblo.yaml Version 1 project, model, field and route definition. .miblo/state.json Pinned packs, fingerprints and merge baselines. .miblo/backups/ Source backups created during model changes. .env Private runtime configuration. .env.example Shareable example. migrations/ Versioned SQL history. Cargo.lock Dependency versions. Commit source, migrations, miblo.yaml and .miblo/state.json. Private .env files are hidden in the explorer; .env.example remains visible.

title: Configuration
text: Variable Purpose DATABASE_URL API connection; database-command fallback when absent from .env. SERVER_ADDRESS / SERVER_PORT Server listener; refresh after changes. MIBLO_TEMPLATE_DIR Local development pack. MIBLO_TEMPLATE_BASE_URL Template distribution server. MIBLO_CACHE_DIR Template cache. VISUAL / EDITOR Editor and arguments. MIBLO_NO_ANIMATION Disables startup animation when set. For the address monitored by the workspace, environment values take priority over .env and project defaults. Wildcard bind addresses are checked through loopback. Avoid conflicting values.

title: Configuration
text: A YAML file can describe a new project: schema_version: 1 name: team-api stack: rust-axum-sqlite port: 3000 resources: - name: User path: /users fields: - name: name type: string miblo new --config path/to/miblo.yaml --yes The destination directory must not exist. Editing this file in an existing project does not migrate its database: use miblo edit to add fields.

title: Configuration
text: Format Version miblo.yaml definition schema_version: 1 Current templates Pack 0.6.0, format 3 Template formats read by the CLI 1, 2 and 3 A project can contain models from different packs. Legacy config.yaml files are not converted automatically. Engine changes, renames and removals require manual migrations.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Resolve template errors, route responses, database status and Rust build problems in Miblo.

title: Troubleshooting
text: miblo doctor --project team-api miblo db check --project team-api doctor checks project metadata and prerequisites. db check tests the connection. Read Logs for the full error.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Check the version, source and access to template releases . Custom URLs need both the archive and its .sha256 sidecar. The workspace lets you change source or retry while keeping the name, destination and port. A failed download does not create the project.

title: Troubleshooting
text: The pinned local pack changed or is missing. Restore its exact content for models that depend on it. For future additions, select a published pack with u or: miblo template update --project team-api This does not rewrite existing models or migration history. Do not delete metadata to bypass the check.

title: Troubleshooting
text: The route uses Logique personnalisée (custom logic). Select it, press e , implement service.rs , then restart. To reuse a model’s SQL directly, create a route with that model and a CRUD action : list, get, create, update or delete.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Displayed status Action Mise à jour BDD requise Stop the API, then b → Appliquer les migrations. Base à initialiser b → Initialiser la base et ses tables. Base inaccessible Check the connection; for MySQL, check the server and credentials. Migration incohérente Restore the applied migration, then write a new migration for the change.

title: Troubleshooting
text: Existing files, modified registries or incompatible code changes can stop generation. Resolve the reported files before retrying. Place manual route registration in src/lib.rs. An interruption may leave .miblo/operation.lock and partial writes. Check that no operation is running, inspect the diff, restore a consistent state, then remove the stale lock. Multi-file writes are not an atomic transaction.

title: Troubleshooting
section: Build failures, busy ports or missing commands
text: Install rustfmt with rustup component add rustfmt . For linker errors, check C/C++ tools. For an occupied port, change SERVER_PORT, refresh with F5 and restart. Check Cargo’s PATH if the command is missing. Bug reports should include version, OS, command and error, without private .env content.

title: Contribute
text: Contribute to Miblo’s open-source CLI, templates and documentation on GitHub.

title: Contribute
text: Miblo : CLI, terminal UI, generation and project management. miblo_templates : Handlebars packs and published archives. miblo_site : this website and documentation. Report bugs, suggest improvements or contribute source changes on GitHub. Miblo uses the MIT license.

title: Contribute
text: cargo fmt --check cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings cargo test --locked Repository scripts also cover installation, generation, migrations, SQLite/MySQL CRUD and the terminal UI. Test dependencies are listed in scripts/requirements-test.txt .

title: Contribute
text: With CLI and template repositories in adjacent directories: cargo build --locked python3 scripts/smoke_sqlite.py \ --miblo target/debug/miblo \ --templates ../miblo_templates/rust_sqlite_template_v4 \ --target-dir target/sqlite-smoke These tests use temporary projects and data. See the development branch README for MySQL, terminal and installation checks and their dependencies.

title: Contribute
text: Check installation, generation from published templates, migrations and preservation of handwritten changes. The automated terminal test runs on Unix; also check the Windows terminal. The CLI, templates and website are published separately. Each repository describes its checks.
